source.author: cic
source.text: si dicis te mentiri verumque dicis, mentiris; dicis autem te mentiri verumque dicis; mentiris igitur.
source.text_original: 'si dicis te mentiri verumque dicis, mentiris; dicis autem te mentiri verumque dicis; mentiris igitur'.
source.text_english: If you say that you are lying and you tell the truth, you are lying; but you say that you are lying and you tell the truth; therefore you are lying.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: si mentiris idque uerum dicis, mentiris et in memet reuersus conuerti in aduersarium propositionis stropham.
reuse.text_original: 'si mentiris idque uerum dicis, mentiris' et in memet reuersus conuerti in aduersarium propositionis stropham.
reuse.text_english: If you are lying and yet say that this is true, you are lying; and, turning back upon myself, I have turned into an opponent through the trickery of the proposition.
